Quotient derivations in Red61/Foliation.lean (the section that was formerly the module
QuotientDerivation, namespace Red61.QuotientDerivation)

The bundle was published by Shuze Chen on 2026-10-15.
Public-contribution license: Apache-2.0, under https://prove2.me/terms .
A copy of that license is provided in LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.

The original generic proof bodies were retained, with project namespace,
minimal mathlib imports, theorem keywords, and formatting adjusted.
The source did not contain a separate copyright notice.
No unrelated platform definition bundles or target stubs were imported.

The former module GlobalSections (now in Red61/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules.lean) uses the
project's pinned mathlib directly. The former modules RationalConstants (now in
Red61/Foliation.lean), Constants (now in Red61/Surface/SixChartModel.lean) and GlobalFunctions
(now in Red61/Surface/Projective.lean) contain new proofs and applications written for this
project.
